document.abstract: This paper provides an overview of the current state of digital HDTV development in the U.S. and the likely prospects for continued progress towards the introduction of commercial products and services. For those who are not intimately familiar with the U.S. situation, this paper summarizes the roles, achievements and status of various key organizations and projects.
